subject: Local Elections Calendar Awareness
posts:
Most people only show up for the big ticket items, but the real work of governance happens in the off-cycle. 

Local Elections Calendar Awareness
Evidence: civic awareness, calendar transparency, increased turnout #LocalGov #Voting

The claim is that local elections are vital and occur year-round, urging citizens to stay engaged beyond the major national cycles. 
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Greater Good

The reality is the dissemination of a calendar that tracks these dates, directly facilitating higher engagement and awareness for local contests. 
Resulting Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Greater Good

Verdict: PASS — The Path of Grace.
The action is a direct, honest effort to increase civic participation in often-overlooked local elections.
This post serves as a reminder to voters that local elections happen throughout the year, providing a link to the Ballotpedia calendar to help citizens track upcoming primary dates in various states.

The Bright Side:
Shifting focus to local elections is the most effective way to impact daily life and community governance.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
No plane error detected. The HOW (calendar link) is a direct, transparent method to achieve the stated WHY (increased voter participation).

The Trajectory: The Path of Grace.
When you map the gap between their stated intent and actual actions...
...it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Good, as it encourages systemic engagement in the most impactful level of government.

The Unavoidable Truth: Local governance has a more immediate impact on daily life than national politics ever will.

The Unavoidable Lie: That only presidential or congressional elections are worth the time to vote.

Alethekanon:
This is a constructive nudge. By providing a centralized calendar, the actor reduces the friction of civic participation, which is a necessary condition for a healthy, self-correcting local system.

Awwthekanon:
It is so easy to miss these important dates. Having a friendly reminder to check the calendar makes it feel like we are all in this together, building a stronger community one vote at a time.

Brothekanon:
People always forget the local stuff, but that's where the potholes get filled and the schools get funded. Good lookin' out on the calendar link.
